name: perlin-noise
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Perlin Noise style. Default variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#101408, #4D7C0F, #A3E635, #F7FEE7). A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
